edges.effect_quant: The strongest quantitative studies point in a harmful direction, but the pooled magnitude varies across populations and methods.
edges.mechanism: Biopersistent asbestos fibers lodge in pleura, provoke chronic macrophage activation, and cause direct chromosomal injury, a textbook pathway toward malignant mesothelioma.
edges.summary: The strongest piece here is the 2026 Seyyedsalehi meta analysis in J Thorac Oncol, which ties asbestos exposure to mesothelioma in a direction that later studies largely support. That makes this edge more about calibrating magnitude and context than arguing over whether the signal exists at all.
edges.caveats: Residual confounding and reverse causation remain possible in some observational studies, so the main readout is direction and plausibility rather than one exact risk number.
